case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You set out copper and labour as the pressure on your costs, and a binding volume is what makes that pressure manageable. All three options below give Selvbrunn a binding volume over a longer contract term, so you are not carrying that risk year by year.

On our price history:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 414.58; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 415.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A is the package we can approve. It combines the binding volume and the longer term with a price level that matches what we have paid so far.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, here is a paragraph you can forward unchanged: Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers Selvbrunn a binding annual volume over a longer contract term for the 7.5 kW frequency converter, at a unit price in line with its recent orders and with a clearly defined payment term. This gives Selvbrunn planning certainty on volume and a stable customer relationship for the whole term.

Please take Option A to your approver. If the committee needs anything further from us to decide, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we acknowledge your historical price data, the sustained increases in our material and labor costs require a price adjustment. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate the commitment to a 24-month contract and a binding volume of 4,580 units, which provides valuable planning certainty. 

Our Angebot is a price of €431.77 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your preferred terms, we propose a unit price of €429.58 with 45 days net payment, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You told us that labour and material costs call for a price adjustment, and that the binding volume and the longer term give you planning certainty.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 421.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.56; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest payment term of the three on the same binding volume and term, and it is the one we ask you to take forward. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For that purpose, here is a paragraph you can forward unchanged:

Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a binding annual volume over a long contract term for the 7.5 kW frequency converter, which gives Selvbrunn secure planning and a stable order base.

Could you please take Option A to the approver? If the committee needs anything further from us to decide, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
